_readme: MEASURED 2026-09-05 against the real captures in public/boh/shots (720x1600, B emulator, sheq@poc at Brito's, Sat 5 Sept; boh-01/boh-02 re-captured 01:15/01:22).
Each box = the target's pixel bounds plus a 10px still-pixel margin (12px on the small labels), normalized 0..1 of the FULL still including the 120px status bar.
color is an Ecowize palette key: sky | skyDeep | emerald | amber | coral. To re-measure: nx = px/720, ny = px/1600.
boh-01 (home) is cropped at 78px, not 120: its status bar overlays the canvas gap between the hero banner and the stat cards (see STILL_CROP_TOP in the comp).
alsoIn: { <still>: { ny } } on a box gives the same target's ny in another still (same margin) — SCROLL_PLAN aligns paired stills on it.
provisional: true = the ring's figures wait for Monday's re-capture (beats 3, 5, 8, 11); with SHOW_PROVISIONAL on, the comp draws these dashed with a coral callout.

Composed rows (COMPOSE_PLAN in the comp): beats 3, 8, 11 overlay narrated figures on real rows; their rings are not provisional. Beat 11 uses boh-02 as its base (Cleaning + PPE rows both visible; boh-06 hides PPE under the nav pill).
